quarterly_data.quarter: Huaqin Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Data center business (annual report): in 2025 shipments of every data-center product grew rapidly and its share at each major customer rose; the portfolio spans AI servers, general-purpose servers, switches and storage servers, and Huaqin says it has core-supplier status at the major CSP customers while expanding industry and channel customers, having developed, adapted and tested products for both overseas and domestic compute platforms. 2026 business plan: keep the CSP-plus-industry-customer strategy and raise purchase share at leading CSPs; AI server market share to stay industry-leading, general-purpose servers and switches to keep growing fast, and supernodes to use a first-mover advantage; data-center R&D to focus on high-speed network data transmission, liquid cooling, high-efficiency power and hardware-software system integration.

quarterly_data.quarter: Huaqin Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Manufacturing footprint: fixed assets rose 57.09% to RMB 12,253,369,969.40 as the headquarters global R&D center came into use, plants of acquired companies were added and equipment and lines were invested to match capacity expansion; in 2025 it acquired PLAMEX S.A. de C.V. in Mexico to extend its 'China + VMI' (Vietnam, Mexico, India) global manufacturing layout, alongside its domestic Dongguan and Nanchang bases.
